set.body: The paired collector only flags a short allowlist of process names. A high-CPU Blender process can evade the gate and contaminate a qualified 20-round receipt. Detect high-CPU processes by utilization regardless of executable name, retain PID/CPU/command evidence, and check between paired processes as well as before each round. Add regression cases for unlisted executables, ordinary idle processes, and own child lifecycle. No threshold or score-budget changes.
set.title: PM3.2b Fail closed on unlisted competing compute
